arguments.message:
Hi there,

A login from an unfamiliar location followed by a change to a sensitive detail such as the billing contact email matches the pattern we treat as a possible account compromise. The next step is to have a human security reviewer look at the activity.

Please change your password immediately and, if possible, reset your two‑factor authentication enrollment to invalidate the compromised session. Then contact our support team directly (you can reply here or email support) so we can review the account activity and reverse any unauthorized changes.

Let us know if you need any help with the password or 2FA reset.

Thanks,
Meridian Support
